LoadColors.name: Load rows of colors into palette buffer
summary: Copies rows of colors from ROM into the palette buffer at $0703 (the CGRAM mirror).
Each row is [$06]+1 colors; after every row the buffer offset advances by $20 (the next 16-color palette).
Parameters: [$00]: source address (bank $00); [$04]: buffer byte offset (color number * 2); [$06]: colors per row - 1; [$08]: rows - 1.
Called with A, X and Y 16-bit. [$00] is left pointing after the last color read.

s00AD1E.name: Table: overworld palette set by map
summary: Indexed by ([$1931] & $0F) - 1; gives the overworld palette set number (0-5) used by CODE_00AD25.

s00AD25.name: Load overworld, title and boss room palettes
summary: $00AD25: overworld palettes. Picks a layer palette set from [$1931] (base $B3D8, or $B732 if bit 7 of [$1EEB] is set) and loads it,
then loads the shared overworld colors from $B528, $B57C and $B5EC.
$00ADA6: title screen palettes (colors 8-F of palettes 0 and 1).
$00ADD9: palettes for the Mode 7 boss rooms with [$0D9B] bit 6 clear (Iggy/Larry). $00AE15: same for the other Mode 7 boss rooms.
All four routines return in 8-bit mode.

s00AE41.name: Tables: color channel shifts and COLDATA bits
summary: DATA_00AE41: shift counts 0, 5, 10. DATA_00AE44: COLDATA plane bits $20, $40, $80. Used by CODE_00AE47.

s00AE47.name: Set fixed color from backdrop color
summary: Writes the backdrop color [$0701] to the PPU fixed color (COLDATA $2132), one channel at a time (blue, green, red).
Called at the end of MoreDMA so that color math against the fixed color matches the backdrop.

s00AE65.name: Tables: color masks, fade steps and dither masks
summary: Used by the level end palette fade (CODE_00AFC0). Masks and -1/+1 steps are per color channel (red, green, blue).
DATA_00AE77: for each 5-bit channel value, two 16-bit masks whose set bits total the value: the channel loses 1 on each step
whose bit is set, so a channel of value v reaches 0 after the 32 steps.

s00AEF7.name: Table: dither step bit masks
summary: 16 one-hot words ($8000 down to $0001) selecting which bit of the dither masks applies on each fade step.

s00AF17.name: Level end dithered palette fade
summary: $00AF17: per-frame level end handler. Counts [$1493] down every other frame (stops at 1). Below $A0 it also forces Mode 1 with BG3 out of color math
and runs the level end sequence (CODE_05CBFF). $00AF35: every 4th frame, while [$1495] < $40, fades palettes 0-7 (colors 1-7), palette 0 colors D-F
and the backdrop by one dithered step. Results go into the CGRAM DMA list at $0905 and [$0680] = 3 queues the upload.
$00AFA3: advances [$1495] by 2 and builds the dither masks [$0C]/[$0E] from the old value.
$00AFC0: one dither step. Parameters: A: original color; [$02]: working color; [$0C], [$0E]: masks. Returns: [$04]: new color.
If [$1493] bit 7 is set each step is +1 instead of -1 (purpose unclear).

Remember.name: Fade helpers: overworld step, sprite palettes
summary: $00B001: tail of CODE_00AFC0 (loops over the three channels). The label name is a stray comment.
$00B006: long-callable dither step used by the overworld ($04:EB4B, which loops it): fades 4 groups of 8 colors, reading [$0783+X],
writing [$0907+X] and [$0979+X] (= source - new color). Purpose of the groups unclear.
$00B03E: level end fade including sprite palettes. Runs CODE_00AF35, then if a step was done builds a second DMA list at $0A05
(colors $81-$F7): player palette copied from [$0D82] unfaded, palettes 9-F faded; list ended at $0AF5.

Palettes?.name: Palette data: backdrop, BG, FG and sprite sets
summary: $B0A0: backdrop colors ([$192F]). $B0B0: 8 background palette sets of 24 bytes ([$1930]), colors 2-7 of palettes 0-1.
$B170: layer 3 colors 8-F of palettes 0-1. $B190: 8 foreground palette sets ([$192D]), colors 2-7 of palettes 2-3.
$B250: colors 2-7 of palettes 4-D. $B2C8: unclear. $B318: 8 sprite palette sets ([$192E]), colors 2-7 of sprite palettes 6-7.
All loaded by LoadPalette ($00ABED); offsets come from DATA_00ABD3 (set * $18). Colors are BGR555.

BowserEndPalette.name: Palette data: Bowser ending, overworld, shared
summary: $B3C0: last sprite palette set, also copied to palettes 5 and 6 for the Bowser ending. $B3D8: 6 overworld sets of 56 bytes (palettes 4-7, colors 1-7).
$B528: overworld colors 9-F of palettes 2-7. $B57C: overworld colors 1-7 of palettes 8-F. $B5EC: colors 8-F of palettes 0-1.
$B5DE: also a table of words read by bank 03 (ending).

MorePalettes.name: Palette data: animated color, title, ending
summary: $B60C: 8-color cycle written to CGRAM color $64 every frame (CODE_00A41C), indexed by [$14] & $1C. $B62C-$B65B: title screen and boss room colors.
$B66C/$B674: small shared palettes. $B69E: 8 entries of 7 colors used by bank 03 (ending) via DATA_03DFC4.
